postgres_requirements.rationale: The aggregate population predicate, the composition writes and the tenancy negatives are all row-level facts that a mocked database cannot prove. The approved-run selection depends on a real join between sroi_calculation_runs and sroi_run_reviews under RLS, and the cross-organization refusals depend on the policies themselves rather than on application code. Run exclusively through pnpm db:audit:disposable against a throwaway container; never staging, never production, never the canonical local stack.

sentinels.purpose: A project in a second organization, named with a recognizable synthetic marker, seeded so that every cross-tenant negative can assert on its ABSENCE by name. If the marker string ever appears in a portfolio read, an aggregate component, an evidence-health count or an intelligence fact, the tenancy boundary leaked.
A calculated run with no approved review, carrying distinctive investment and net-value magnitudes, so that its contribution to any total is detectable arithmetically rather than only by inspection.
A pre-PC-01B run (methodology_version NULL) with distinctive magnitudes, proving the FIBC-042 legacy exclusion by arithmetic absence from both numerator and denominator.

positive_controls.description: The aggregate selects, per member project, the most recent run whose review row has status='approved' — ordered by run version DESC then calculated_at DESC — and no other run.

portfolioSroiRatio equals SUM(net_social_value) / SUM(total_investment) over exactly the included population, computed with decimal.js, and equals neither the mean nor the median nor any weighted average of the individual project ratios (proved with a fixture where those four values are pairwise distinct).

Every included component carries the full traceability tuple projectId, projectName, runId, runVersion, reviewId, methodologyVersion, sroiRatio, totalInvestment, netSocialValue, and the runId it carries is the run whose reviewId is approved.
A portfolio mixing methodology versions across its approved runs still emits an aggregate, each component reports its own methodologyVersion, and the mixed state is reported rather than hidden.
Descriptive statistics over individual ratios (minimum, median, maximum) are computed and returned under their own names, distinct from portfolioSroiRatio.
A run whose project has a locked report and a run whose project has no report at all participate identically: report state is not an eligibility input (FIBC-038).

For a portfolio with more members than one comparison page, the aggregate computed through the paginated surface is byte-identical to the aggregate computed with no pagination, and projectCount, includedCount and the excluded list describe the whole portfolio on every page.
The read model issues a bounded number of statements independent of member count: chunked at PORTFOLIO_READ_MODEL_CHUNK_SIZE, the statement count is ceil(N/chunk) per read and never N.
canManagePortfolio resolves exactly to super_admin, organization_admin and impact_manager, and every composition path consults the helper rather than an inline array.
Create, rename, archive, assign, unassign and move each succeed for an impact_manager within their own organization and each emits its frozen audit verb with the correct entityType.

Moving a project from portfolio A to portfolio B is ONE UPDATE producing ONE audit row carrying both endpoints; no intermediate state in which the project belongs to no portfolio is ever observable, and no unassign verb is emitted.
An archived portfolio remains readable and keeps its aggregate, while its member projects remain active and assigned — archiving groups, never ownership.
Each of the six evidence-health indicators returns a count with an explicit denominator and the source identifiers needed to drill to the objects counted.

Sufficiency determinations are read for the SELECTED run through the existing batch primitive getLatestSufficiencyDeterminationsByOutcomeIds, so a determination recorded for another run never satisfies this one.
Each of the eight deterministic transversal facts is computed from persisted rows and is reproducible from them, with source identifiers attached.
Against a real disposable PostgreSQL, an impact_manager in organization A reads the portfolio, its aggregate and its evidence-health counts under uellix_app with the identity context open.

negative_controls.description: A calculated run with NO approved review contributes to neither numerator nor denominator, and its project is excluded with reason no_approved_run while remaining visible. Asserted arithmetically via SENT-PF-UNAPPROVED-RUN.
A run more recent than the selected approved run does not replace it and does not alter any aggregate value.

A legacy run (projects.governance_regime='pre_pc01b' or sroi_calculation_runs.methodology_version IS NULL) is excluded with reason legacy_non_authoritative. Asserted arithmetically via SENT-PF-LEGACY-RUN.
A non-USD run is excluded with reason non_usd_currency and is never converted: no FX rate is read on any Portfolio path.
A run with sroi_ratio NULL is excluded with reason no_sroi_ratio and its investment never enters the denominator.
A run with total_investment null, zero or negative is excluded with reason zero_or_invalid_investment rather than contributing a zero to the denominator.
When every member is excluded, or the summed denominator is zero, portfolioSroiRatio is null and the impossibility is represented explicitly — never 0, never omitted, never a silent absence.
No descriptive statistic is ever returned under the name of the consolidated ratio, and the consolidated ratio is never returned as a descriptive statistic.

No Portfolio path reads readiness_assessments before FIBIU-17 exists, and the manual readiness_score display is byte-unchanged from the base — same value, same coverage counter, same badge thresholds. Portion D of FIBIU-27 has not been smuggled in.
An analyst can neither create, rename, archive, assign, unassign nor move. This pins the deliberate narrowing recorded in the authority.
A viewer and a reviewer can read every Portfolio surface and can perform no composition.
No inline role array survives anywhere in the Portfolio implementation paths; every gate consults canManagePortfolio.

A project belonging to organization B cannot be assigned to a portfolio in organization A: the write is refused by the application check and, independently, by RLS. Asserted with SENT-PF-CROSS-ORG-PROJECT.

A portfolio in organization B is not readable from organization A, and its projects never appear in A's aggregate, evidence-health counts or transversal facts. The sentinel marker appears in no output.
Every Portfolio query is organization-bound: no read or write omits the organization predicate.
Assign, unassign and move are all refused against an ARCHIVED portfolio.
A move whose source portfolio no longer matches updates zero rows and is refused, never retried and never silently converted into an assign.

No Portfolio path writes to sroi_calculation_runs, sroi_run_reviews, sroi_reports, evidence_items, evidence_versions, evidence_sufficiency_determinations or outcome_monetization_dispositions. Portfolio cannot become an approval bypass into Measure. Asserted structurally over the implementation paths.
No Portfolio path calls a Stella action, builds a Stella context, or issues an operation ticket; and no Portfolio surface claims an advisory capability. V1 has no Stella on Portfolio.
No Portfolio read loads an evidence body, an evidence content column or any audit_logs row.
The Portfolio diff contains no migration, no db/schema.ts change, no db/prepared change and no edit to the three pages' runWithOptionalOrganizationAccess call sites, which are S1-owned.
Against a real disposable PostgreSQL, a member of organization A with the identity context open reads zero rows of organization B's portfolios and projects.

mutation_controls.description: Replacing the approved-run predicate with the base status='calculated' predicate makes NEG-AGG-1 fail. Proves the P0 correction is actually load-bearing.
Replacing SUM/SUM with the mean of the individual ratios makes POS-AGG-2 fail.
Removing the legacy exclusion makes NEG-AGG-3 fail.
Reintroducing any ratio fallback that recomputes net/investment when the persisted sroi_ratio is NULL makes NEG-AGG-5 fail.
Dropping runId or reviewId from an included component makes POS-AGG-3 fail, so a detached aggregate without source identifiers cannot ship.
Feeding the paginated row set into aggregatePortfolioSroi instead of the full member set makes POS-SIZE-1 fail. This is the control that prevents an aggregate silently covering only the current page.
Widening canManagePortfolio to analyst makes NEG-PERM-1 fail.
Implementing move as unassign followed by assign makes POS-COMP-3 fail on the audit-row count.
Removing the organization predicate from the project lookup in assign makes NEG-TENANT-1 fail at the application layer while RLS still refuses, proving both layers are independently non-vacuous.
Adding a Portfolio server action without registering it in tests/database-entrypoint-inventory.json fails the closed-world entrypoint test. This is the exact omission that produced blocker B3-BLK-A.
Pointing any Portfolio read at readiness_assessments, or re-labelling the manual score with the canonical FIBC-021 band vocabulary, makes NEG-READINESS-1 fail.
